paper.title_en: First law of thermodynamics for interacting charged black holes and applications
paper.abstract_en: We derive a mass variation identity expressing the first law of black hole thermodynamics for asymptotically flat, stationary, axisymmetric Einstein-Maxwell solutions with multiple electrically charged horizons and finite conical axis singularities. Under the stated asymptotic and parameter regularity hypotheses, the identity holds for independent variations of all parameters within families of fixed horizon types. On the all-degenerate family, a correction to the ADM mass defines a scalar function whose derivatives with respect to angular momenta are the horizon angular velocities. At the Majumdar-Papapetrou family, its angular momentum Hessian is positive definite. Combining the first variation identity with a separate theorem on the sign of the conical parameters shows that this Hessian is nondecreasing in the positive-semidefinite order along admissible paths of increasing Weyl gaps at fixed positive charges.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在渐近平直、稳态轴对称 Einstein-Maxwell 解（含多个带电视界与有限锥轴奇点）的框架下推导了黑洞热力学第一定律的质量变分恒等式，并进一步讨论了全退化族与 Majumdar-Papapetrou 族的角动量 Hessian 性质及单调性结论。理论深度高、方法信号明确，与黑洞热力学主题高度相关，值得点击细读。
decision.title_zh: 相互作用带电黑洞的热力学第一定律及其应用
decision.abstract_zh: 我们推导出一个质量变分恒等式，用以表达渐近平直、稳态、轴对称的 Einstein-Maxwell 解（具有多个带电视界和有限锥轴奇点）的黑洞热力学第一定律。在所声明的渐近与参数正则性假设下，该恒等式对固定视界类型族内所有参数的独立变分成立。在全退化族上，对 ADM 质量的一个修正定义了一个标量函数，其对角动量的导数即为视界角速度。在 Majumdar-Papapetrou 族上，其角动量 Hessian 是正定的。将一阶变分恒等式与关于锥参数符号的另一定理相结合，可表明：在固定正电荷下沿 Weyl 间隙递增的可容许路径，该 Hessian 在半正定序下是不减的。
